title: Topic 1: Pets & Animals
content:
1. Do you have a pet at home, or have you ever had one?
2. What are the benefits of keeping pets for children and families?
3. What is the most popular type of pet in your country?

questions.answer: Yes, I currently have a small dog at home, and I am a big fan of keeping pets.
questions.example: Every evening, I take my dog for a walk in the park near my house with my younger brother.
questions.q: Do you have a pet at home, or have you ever had one?
questions.reason: Keeping a household pet brings warm companionship every day. It is advantageous to my mental health because playing with him helps me relax my mind, relieve stress, and elevate my mood after a day of hard work.

questions.answer: I think keeping pets brings a lot of merits to both children and families.
questions.example: At weekends, my family takes turns feeding and bathing our dog, which makes us feel over the moon and closer to each other.
questions.q: What are the benefits of keeping pets for children and families?
questions.reason: It strengthens bonds within a family when everyone cares for the animal together, and it teaches children important values and life skills like responsibility. Also, walking pets outdoors helps family members stay fit and healthy.

questions.answer: Certainly, dogs and cats are the most popular pets in Vietnam.
questions.example: Most families in my neighborhood keep a dog or a cat, provided that owners clean up after their animals in public areas.
questions.q: What is the most popular type of pet in your country?
questions.reason: Dogs are loyal and friendly, while cats are clean, quiet, and fit comfortably within a family's budget and daily routine. Both bring great comfort at home.

2. Which family member do you find it easiest to confide in or talk to about personal matters?

title: Topic 3: Family Responsibilities & Rules
content:
1. What important rules or principles do you think every family should have?
2. Which family member do you find it easiest to confide in or talk to about personal matters?
3. How should household responsibilities and chores be shared fairly among family members?

questions.answer: In my opinion, every family should have rules about showing respect, open communication, and spending quality time together.
questions.example: In my family, we have a rule that everyone puts away their phones at dinner so we can talk face-to-face.
questions.q: What important rules or principles do you think every family should have?
questions.reason: When parents and children openly and respectfully share their thoughts and listen with patience, it avoids family conflicts and builds a strong sense of belonging through face-to-face interaction.

questions.answer: The person I find it easiest to talk to is my mom, because my family means the world to me and she is very understanding and supportive.
questions.example: Whenever I feel stressed about school or friends, I share everything with my mom in the evening after dinner.
questions.q: Which family member do you find it easiest to confide in or talk to about personal matters?
questions.reason: She loves me unconditionally, is always beside me when I face difficulties, and provides guidance for my personal growth. She is a great source of inspiration and motivation for me.

questions.answer: Certainly, household chores should be shared fairly among all family members based on their age and free time.
questions.example: In my home, my mom cooks dinner, I wash the dishes, and my dad takes out the trash every day.
questions.q: How should household responsibilities and chores be shared fairly among family members?
questions.reason: Sharing daily housework teaches children practical life skills and prevents mothers from carrying the entire family burden alone. It also helps everyone reach a healthy balance between work and family time.

questions.answer: Yes, my family regularly sorts and recycles household waste like cardboard boxes, plastic bottles, and drink cans.

questions.q: Do you or your family regularly recycle household waste like paper, plastic, or cans?

questions.example: For instance, my neighborhood puts clear signs on recycling bins and organizes green weekends for residents.
questions.q: What can local communities and governments do to encourage people to recycle more?
questions.reason: At the macro level, authorities should invest public funds into placing more recycling bins and launching community education campaigns to raise the public's awareness. They can also introduce stricter rules and heavy fines for littering.

questions.answer: Yes, I strongly think each individual can make a big contribution to protecting the environment.
questions.example: In my daily life, I always carry a reusable water bottle and cloth bag to the supermarket instead of using single-use plastic.
questions.q: Do you think individuals can make a real difference in protecting the environment by recycling?
questions.reason: When citizens actively choose green habits—such as sorting waste and conserving water—those small daily actions together help solve the problem of pollution and improve people's living standard.
